name: Velari
notes: Ancient, long-lived, bipedal humanoid species with adaptable physiology (survives harsh or terraformed environments); elongated form and high brain plasticity drove early technological dominance. Founders of the Velar Imperium (a technocratic monarchy of genetically engineered nobles and cyber-enhanced philosopher-kings). Cultural namesake of Vel-Surak. Primary polity: Velar Imperium.

naming_exemption.reason: Species name "Velari" preserved verbatim from the cited species/civilization codex.

distribution: Founding species of the Velar Imperium, but the Velari PEOPLE are not the Imperium STATE: Velari also live Union-aligned (e.g. the Velari-heritage world Vel-Surak sits in the Union) and drove the Republican Reformist movement. Imperial, reformist, and Union-aligned Velari all coexist.
cultural_note: "Velari" denotes the people and cultural heritage; "Velar Imperium" is one (fragmented) political expression of that heritage, not its whole. The Vel-Surak placement ruling (2026-07-21) turns on exactly this species≠state distinction.
identity_model_note: Species = a people (biology + broad cultural origin). Membership is not bounded by any single polity/faction; see member_polities (non-exhaustive) and distribution.

promotion_to_canon.rule: owner directive: promote all staged records that do not conflict with canon
promotion_to_canon.conflict_scan: zero name/office collisions; fabric linter clean; position axis unchanged

biology.form: Elongated humanoids with adaptive genetic morphologies.
biology.adaptation: Survive hostile environments through selective organ modulation.
biology.appearance: Skin patterns shift in subtle colour hues with age or emotional resonance.
biology.lifespan_significance: Age is considered a mark of political wisdom or divine favour.
biology.consistency_check: Corroborates the existing record, which already described adaptable physiology and an elongated form from the species codex. Adds lifespan, the mechanism of adaptation, and the social meaning of age — none of which canon held.

culture.expression: Artistic expression is intertwined with technological mastery.

origin_polity_id_note: origin_polity_id carries the FACTION-binding form ("velar_imperium"), which is also what polity_velar_imperium.faction_bindings uses — so the value is meaningful, not a typo. It is simply not an entity id. origin_polity_entity_id is added alongside rather than rewriting it, the same additive pattern used when entity_id was added beside canonical_id, so neither namespace is lost.
